title: IBM Concert 1.0 through 3.0.1.1 contains components that allow potentially unsafe command execution, which could be…
description: IBM Concert versions 1.0 through 3.0.1.1 contain components that allow potentially unsafe command execution. This vulnerability could be exploited to execute arbitrary system commands on the host, leading to full compromise. The flaw is identified as CWE-78 and has a critical CVSS score of 9.8.
